comparison_contract.replacement_rule: Attach a replacement query ID only when its current SQL signature, request path, parameter class, and response purpose match the old purpose. Never compare a rewritten statement to its old query ID or map a faster statement with a different output shape.
comparison_contract.route_timing_rule: Statement timing comes from pg_stat_statements. Route P50/P95/P99 must be reported separately from normalized FastAPI histograms, Next admin timing headers/logs, or browser admin-load samples, with cache cohort and sample count.

measurements.old_sql_signature: with filtered_posts as materialized; post_totals; instagram_post_comment_rollups; comment_accounting
measurements.replacement_sql_signature: owner_post_keys plus collaborator_post_keys plus filtered_post_keys; typed post totals and one instagram_post_comment_rollups join; separate avatar_totals; final cross join avatar_totals
measurements.remap_note: The final zero-temp typed/key-first fingerprint clears the 80% mean/shared-work and no-worse-temp gates. Its 175.8 ms minimum is consistent with the 248 ms warm route probe, while its 4,749.3 ms maximum explains less than half of the 10.9 s cold route probe; old and superseded profile fingerprints did not gain calls.

measurements.replacement_sql_signature: typed fast path: no raw payload matching or jsonb_to_record; typed comments_count; sidecar form uses lateral ID-only existence joins with limit 1
measurements.remap_note: The final typed legacy and ID-only sidecar statements match the accepted 2025+ completion purpose, clear the 80% mean/shared-work gate, and have zero temp spill. Raw-compatible IDs remain valid only for pre-2025 or schema-fallback execution and are excluded from this accepted mapping. Three privacy-safe compare events were equal with zero required or benign mismatches. The 9.34-second first compare route is retained as a cold-start outlier; two warm compare and three warm legacy samples are too few for P95 or the required 24-hour soak.
